subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should existing Control UI and ClickClack `?session=` deep links remain supported through a deprecation redirect, or is breaking all previously shared and bookmarked links an accepted product decision?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a released user-facing URL contract rather than repairing an internal implementation detail; tests can prove either behavior but cannot decide the acceptable upgrade policy.

options.title: Preserve and canonicalize legacy links
options.body: Accept old query-form session links, resolve them once, and replace the URL with the stable path form during a documented deprecation period.

options.title: Accept the breaking URL change
options.body: Merge the path-only contract and explicitly accept that existing bookmarks and ClickClack history links will fail after upgrade.

options.title: Pause the route migration
options.body: Keep the PR open until a narrower migration policy and public deep-link contract are agreed.

recommendation.title: Preserve and canonicalize legacy links
recommendation.body: Accept old query-form session links, resolve them once, and replace the URL with the stable path form during a documented deprecation period.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author and assignee proposed the new shared URL contract and can clarify the intended upgrade policy.
